title: ARCH-D10-04: make authority gate visible
description: Post-E3 maintenance candidate. Evidence: docs/evidence/2026-10-06-post-d10-architecture-audit.md#arch-d10-04--visible-host-neutral-authority-gate-third. Trigger: separately reviewed post-E3 check-tier change. Make the existing real SQLite authority suite an explicit portable lane for affected authority/recovery changes while preserving headless simulation and native pause.
acceptance_criteria: A planted authority/recovery source change misrouted away from the lane makes the classifier test fail; existing SQLite forgery controls pass in the required lane; independent review closes the task.

title: ARCH-D10-05: coordinate compiler and loader definition admission
description: Post-E3 maintenance candidate. Evidence: docs/evidence/2026-10-06-post-d10-architecture-audit.md#arch-d10-05--coordinated-compilerloader-admission-lists-fourth. Trigger: adding the next definition. Prefer a small exhaustive list or existing contract-derived list only if it removes repetition; retain independent compiler and loader trust-boundary validation.
acceptance_criteria: Omitting that definition admission hook makes independently malformed source/artifact checks fail; independent review closes the task.

title: ARCH-D10-02: make receipt recovery ownership explicit
description: Post-E3 maintenance candidate. Evidence: docs/evidence/2026-10-06-post-d10-architecture-audit.md#arch-d10-02--explicit-recovery-ownership-first. Trigger: recovery next gains a consumer. Review receiptRecovery -> liquidSave -> receiptHistory, then consider moving the existing replay invocation to the recovery coordinator while retaining applicability and row validation. Preserve explicit save refusal and owner save bytes.
acceptance_criteria: At the trigger, prove population-only malformed history is refused when replay is bypassed; retain existing forged-group controls; independently review the smallest repair.

title: ARCH-D10-03: make durable target mapping exhaustive
description: Post-E3 maintenance candidate. Evidence: docs/evidence/2026-10-06-post-d10-architecture-audit.md#arch-d10-03--exhaustive-durable-target-mapping-second. Trigger: before the next durable target. Check string-indexed row mapping and adoption of all non-clock MutationTarget kinds, preserving changed-row writes and structural sharing.
acceptance_criteria: Removing one current mapping must fail typechecking; the consuming target passes real SQLite reopen; independent review closes the task.
